note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Colorado 2025 First Special Session (LegiScan 2224). The special session was held by the same legislature as the 2025 regular session, so this file reuses that session's reviewed crosswalk: 98 of the 99 members appear in both, and the fresh proposer run agreed with all 51 mapped proposals with no difference. Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, never its `role` field. Lori Garcia Sander (26066) stays hand-mapped because our roster spells her Lori Sander. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null.
